articles.body:
Hi Jonas,

Second dry run finished last night. Source system reports 128 440 cases, Grantly ended up with 127 902. That is 538 missing and I cannot see a pattern by year or by region.

I have the run id and the reject log if you want them.

--
Tobias Ahl
Architect, Regionalt Utvecklingsverket
tobias.ahl@ruv.se
articles.subject: Migration dry run 2: record counts do not match

articles.body:
Hi Tobias,

Yes please, send the reject log. My first guess is the cases that have no decision date at all; our importer requires one and the loader would have pushed those to the reject file rather than failing the run.

Regards,
Jonas
articles.subject: Re: Migration dry run 2: record counts do not match

articles.body:
> My first guess is the cases that have no decision date at all

Good guess. 511 of the 538 have an empty decision date, all from 2019-2020 when that field was optional in the old system. The remaining 27 are duplicates on our side that we should not migrate anyway.

We need a rule for the 511. Options as I see them: import with the registration date as decision date, or import them as not decided. That is a business decision, not mine.

/Tobias
articles.subject: Re: Migration dry run 2: record counts do not match

articles.body: Technically we can do either. Waiting on the agency to decide. Flagged in the migration channel as well.
